map.循经感传是什么？: What is propagated sensation along channels?
map.针刺或按压时酸麻胀感沿经脉路线传导的现象，是经气运行的可感知表现，存在个体差异。: The soreness, numbness and distension spreading along the meridian course during needling or acupressure is the perceptible expression of meridian qi moving, with individual variation.
map.经络有解剖实体吗？: Do meridians have an anatomical entity?
map.经络是中医对人体联络系统的功能概括，现代研究有多种假说，尚未对应单一解剖结构；本: Meridians are how traditional Chinese medicine functionally summarizes the body's connecting system; modern research offers several hypotheses and no single anatomical structure has been matched to them; this tool is for study reference.
